palette: deep teal-green night ground + brass instrument rings + pale chart parchment panels + silver star points + dusk coral warnings + ink chart annotations

composition: the definition stands as a chart plaque with three feature panels; deduction draws as a three-step syllogism descent toward the verdict; induction and analogy rest as twin chart plates; abduction, reverse and a-fortiori queue as three instrument columns; the verdict map lays six mode flags on a reading grid
surface: flat deep teal-green night with faint brass graticule hairlines, parchment chart panels with hairline borders, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: chart panels slide onto the reading desk, graticule strokes ink in, the syllogism descends step by step, mode flags swing in and hold
transition: a night wipe sweeps the previous chart off the desk
